QuestInfo.name: Using Skills
QuestInfo.0: Learn how to use skills from Mai.
QuestInfo.1:
Learn how to use skills from Mai.

#b#eTip:#n Learn skills by investing SP (skill points) in them. You'll earn SP by leveling up. Press [K] to open the Skill window and check out your skills. 
Hotkey your favorite skills by dragging skill icons to the hotkey window.#k
QuestInfo.2:
You have learned how to use skills from Mai.

#b#eTip:#n Learn skills by investing SP (skill points) in them. You'll earn SP by leveling up. Press [K] to open the Skill window and check out your skills.

0.0: Supposedly, you'll get #bAP#k to improve your stats and #bSP#k to train your skills each time you gain a level. But this is stuff I only understand in theory, since I've never leveled up myself. Sigh.
0.1: You can manually distribute your AP, or you can use the\r\n#bAuto-Assign#k button to do it automatically. For your skills, press #b[K]#k to open your Skill window, where you can spend your SP.
0.2: Go on and press #b[K]#k to open your Skill window now! I've always wanted to see it in action!

yes.0: You should hotkey your favorite skills. Just drag the skill icons from the Skill window to the hotkey window, and you'll be able to use your skills at the touch of a, well, hotkey!

no.0: You're not refusing because you don't want me to watch, are you? How mean!

1.0: You'll get all sorts of skills as you level up. Offensive skills, stat-boosting skills, movement skills... I've memorized the entire list. If I could learn even one skill, I would die happy!
1.1: Part of the challenge is figuring out which skills to level up first. But I'm sure a genius like you will have no problem with that!
1.2: And I'm sure you'll also remember to #bhotkey#k your favorite consumable items and skills, WITHOUT needing to write it on your hand.

yes.0: I've think I've shared with you just about everything I've learned from 8 years of Hero School. I just have one last little surprise...
